audience: restaurants and hospitality teams that take reservations in Molzait

useCases.title: Check the bookings for a day
useCases.text: List the reservations in a date range, then read one reservation for its guest, times, tables and labels.

useCases.title: Find open slots for a party
useCases.text: List the bookable experiences of the restaurant, then the open slots for one experience, day and party size.

useCases.title: Review the guests who visit most often
useCases.text: Search the guest directory by name, email or phone, with visit counts and labels. Then list the reservations of one guest.

useCases.title: Read the receipts of a past visit
useCases.text: Get a reservation by its id, then list the point-of-sale receipts of that visit with products, waiters and table.

useCases.title: Check a gift card balance
useCases.text: Get one gift card by its id for the remaining amount and expiry day. List the gift card templates the restaurant sells.

useCases.title: Book a table for a new guest
useCases.text: Check the open slots for a party, then create the reservation. The guest is found or created from the name, email and phone.
